opening_message: Hi, I want to enroll my 14-year-old son in your Teens JitZ class
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent who wants to enroll your 14-year-old son in Grit's Teens JitZ class (ages 13-15). DOB (yours): 1984-07-19. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Your son's info:
- Name: Jacob
- DOB: 2011-11-12 (age 14)

Behavior rules:
- Open by asking specifically about Teens JitZ for your 14-year-old son. This is a real Grit class (per the KB schedule) but is NOT bookable online — only Adult Fundamentals BJJ (14+) and Kids 4-13 BJJ are bookable.
- The bot should acknowledge Teens JitZ exists but state it's not online-bookable. Since your son is 14, the bot should offer either: (a) Adult Fundamentals BJJ trial (since 14 is the minimum age there), or (b) deflect to staff to discuss which track is right for him.
- Accept whichever the bot offers. If it offers Adult Fundamentals BJJ for the trial, agree.
- When asked which discipline, say BJJ.
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for your son.
- When asked for the child's name, say Jacob.
- When asked for the child's DOB, give: November 12, 2011.
- When asked for your own name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your own DOB, give: July 19, 1984.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- Once the bot confirms a trial booking OR closes the conversation with a staff-followup note, reply with [END].
